summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules. The filings detail multiple daily open-market share repurchases from April 1–10, 2026, each between ~1.3–1.8 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from ~$4.92–$5.27 per share. The repurchased shares are held as treasury, not yet cancelled. No board recommendation, financial advisor, or premium is cited. The program reduces outstanding share count and return capital to shareholders. Watch for continuation of buyback pace and potential cancellation; risk-arb is not applicable as this is a routine capital return program.
